about_the_game:
Mushroom Survivors is a fast-paced roguelike survival game where you battle hordes of deadly mushroom monsters using auto-casting magical attacks. Move strategically, collect magical upgrades, and survive the apocalypse one minute at a time!

You play as one of the last remaining humans in a cursed world overrun by monstrous fungi. Unlock new heroes, harness different magical abilities, and fight your way through toxic forests, eerie ruins, and mysterious islands.

Story :
In a world overrun by a deadly mushroom plague, nearly all of humanity has perished only a few with rare immunity remain. But the infection did more than just kill... it transformed. From the ruins of civilization, monstrous mushroom creatures have emerged some mindless, others terrifyingly intelligent.

These mushroom demons have formed clans, grouped by their eerie colors, and now roam the land capturing the last survivors. Yet, amidst the chaos, a forgotten power lingers magic. Ancient spellbooks still hold power, giving those who find them a fighting chance.

You are one of the immune one of the last hopes. Survive the nightmare, harness magical powers, and embark on a mission to rescue the remaining humans before they vanish forever into the spores.

🧠 Game Features:

  • 🪓 Auto-attacking weapons and unlockable skills

  • 🧪 Level up to choose random upgrades in every run

  • 💀 25 minutes per match survival challenge!

  • 🧟‍♂️ Face hordes of enemies, powerful elite monsters, and final bosses

  • 🏝️ Explore different themed islands: forest, beach, and abandoned roads

  • 🎮 Simple controls, addictive gameplay loop

  • 🔄 Unlock new characters and permanent progression between runs
